youtube.title: Why Indian Currency Notes Have Those Black Bars (It’s Not Design)
youtube.description: Why do those dark slanted bars sit on the edge of your banknotes? They are not decoration and not a forger's code. They are raised intaglio ink, called bleed lines, made so a visually impaired person can read a note's value with one swipe of a thumb. Four lines on a 100, dots on a 200, five lines on a 500. Discover the story of trust, touch and pride behind the humble rupee note. #TheHiddenWhy #facts #explained
